title: Send Agent-Built iOS Builds Straight to an iPhone
summary: iCodesign demonstrates a remote iOS feedback loop in which a coding agent packages a completed build, returns a link or QR code, and installs it on an iPhone without a TestFlight upload or processing delay. An iOS team can reserve this path for trusted internal devices and use it to test agent changes on hardware before entering the release pipeline.
takeaway: Close the remote-agent loop on trusted hardware with a direct install link, while keeping signing controls and App Store distribution as separate release gates.
